company.name: Standard Cognition
company.shortDescription: Standard Cognition provides an autonomous checkout tool that can be installed into retailers’ existing stores.
company.description:
Standard Cognition is an artificial intelligence platform that allows buyers to grab what they want without having to go to a cashier. It empowers consumers to shop and pay without waiting in line, scanning or stopping to check out. Available to any retailer, the solution helps reduce labor costs, improve the customer experience, and improve profit margins. It also helps small-size retailers to compete with larger chains and online offerings.

Standard Cognition was founded in 2017 and is based in San Francisco, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: Standard Cognition is researching systems and methods for autonomous checkout in cashier-less stores, focusing on camera and sensor based monitoring of real space. Titles such as Systems and methods to check-in shoppers in a cashier-less store and One or more cameras for use in an autonomous checkout in a cashier-less shopping store, along with abstracts on tracking subjects, inventory items, and item sizes, show work on shopper identification, pose and action recognition, inventory tracking, and automated camera calibration.
